about:
Sterling Wire Products, Inc. operates from Rock Falls, Illinois. For nearly 50 years, the company has focused on reliable shaped wire solutions, building a reputation for on-time delivery and attention to unique customer requirements.

The company manufactures shaped wire and straightened-and-cut wire in forms that include flat, rectangular, rolled round edge, square, and custom-edged profiles. It offers annealing to spring temper for springs, clips, rings, and hardware, and produces custom shapes such as half rounds, keystones, specified corner radii, and knurling. Materials range from aluminum to specialty alloys such as Preco Z, with products supplied as coils, spools, or straightened and cut lengths. The shop also accepts prototype orders that other suppliers may decline.

Sterling Wire Products serves customers ranging from global corporations to small shops that need custom specifications. Its wire products find use in applications such as springs, clips, rings, and hardware across various industrial sectors.

The company emphasizes domestic production — marked "SHAPED IN THE U.S.A." — and differentiates itself through short lead times, responsive service, and a willingness to handle prototype runs that others cannot or will not accommodate.
